newsitem.title: SWEDEN: MORGAN STANLEY LOWERS SWEDISH FORESTRY VIEWS.
newsitem.headline: MORGAN STANLEY LOWERS SWEDISH FORESTRY VIEWS.

text.p: Morgan Stanley on Friday said it was cutting its recommendations on Swedish forestry company MoDo and Stora .
Morgan Stanley lowered its recommendation on MoDo to an underperform from a strong buy.
It lowered its recommendation on Stora to neutral from a strong buy.
"We have downgraded MoDo to underperform and Stora to neutral (both from strong buy)," analyst Mads Asprem told Reuters.
He said the downgrade happened on Wednesday and was triggered partly by a pessimistic outlook for the pulp market.
"We believe that pulp production is too high and that stocks are too high," Asprem said.

He questioned figures released on by pulp and paper consultant Momentum this week that showed stocks held by North American and Scandinavian (NorScan) producers rose 50,000 tonnes in August to 1.75 million tonnes.
Asprem said he believed the rise was more of the order of 80,000 tonnes. -- Joel Dahlberg, Stockholm newsroom +46-8-700
